docker-compose.description: The stack's compose file only exists as its components' Jinja fragments, roles/<component>/templates/docker-compose.yaml.j2 (raspberry#238, #14).

packageRules.description: Auto merge all minor and patch updates to github-actions. Do it without a PR to reduce noise.

Update the Ansible dev tools together: ansible-lint in requirements.txt and .pre-commit-config.yaml (so local runs, pre-commit and CI use the same version), and molecule and molecule-plugins, which are usually released alongside it.
Update ansible-core in requirements.txt and the ansible-lint pre-commit hook together.
